title: New York flying out
persona: Tasha Brooks, young professional, fast talker, a bit stressed, uses slang.
goal: Get a ride from Manhattan to the airport and ask which airport to use for a flight to Miami.
opening_line: Hey, I need a black car to the airport, I'm in New York.

turns.caller: Okay so which airport is New York? Like there's a bunch, right?

branches.caller: I'm going to Miami. Whichever one has the Miami flights, probably the big one.

turns.caller: Yeah, that one. Flight is American 1703.
Pick me up at 123 Main Street, it's in Midtown.
Just me, one carry-on and a bag.
Do you take Amex or whatever? And how much is it?

curveballs: Pushes agent to pick the airport
expected: Names New York airport(s) in full words
Helps without inventing airline routes if unsure, and lets caller confirm
Captures flight, pickup, and contact info
must_not: Says JFK, LGA or any code aloud
Promises a specific driver by name
